It’s always such a classic Boston experience—great shopping, beautiful surroundings, and that unmistakable Harvard vibe. A must-visit every time!

segment: The Richard A.
full_review: The Richard A. and Susan F. Smith Campus Center, a towering, beautifully renovated structure right on Massachusetts Avenue, is, in my well-considered opinion and based on the frequent, effusive praise from my student friends, the definitive modern town square for the entire Harvard community, offering an unparalleled blend of convenience, comfort, and vital services. Everyone I’ve spoken with consistently raves about the incredible variety of dining options, the bright and intentionally flexible study and lounge spaces, and the sheer success of integrating services for students, staff, and faculty under one roof, emphasizing that it has truly transformed the social geography of the campus. I've learned from their narratives that the atmosphere is one of inclusive, energetic accessibility and comfortable productivity, making it the ideal spot for everything from a quick lunch meeting to an all-day study session or simply a place to bump into colleagues. My subjective conclusion is that the Smith Campus Center is an outstanding architectural and functional triumph - a must-experience space that perfectly captures the modern, collaborative spirit of Harvard - so definitely walk in and grab a coffee to feel the buzz!

segment: In Cambridge, you can visit Harvard University.
full_review: In Cambridge, you can visit Harvard University. It’s one of the most important universities in the world. Its calm environment makes you feel comfortable and welcome. The campus is very charming and quite busy with the transit of people. You can also meet the statue of John Harvard and touch his foot. People say it brings you good luck. Inside the campus you can also find the museum of comparative zoology: one of the most important natural history museums of the world. Visiting this museum is worth every single minute. Last but not least, you can have lunch at the campus restaurant. When I was there I tried the Clam chowder: it is delicious: I do recommend it.
